rules.note: `K < x` is written `x >= K + 1`: MWCC compiles the strict form to a set-less-than into the assembler temporary and the non-strict form into the result register, the shape a source of the original produces. Leave-one-out over the seven PS2 C-output lanes (m22 objdiff match, rule off -> on): neutral on dds, ff, gh, rc, rcpal; it helped Dark Chronicle (MWCC 3.0, linker stamp 2.4: exact 31 -> 33, mean 60.976 -> 61.045) and hurt Dark Cloud (MWCC 2.3.3, linker stamp 2.3: exact 27 -> 26, 10 functions better and 9 worse). The two are told apart by the Metrowerks linker stamp in the compiler id (`mwcc-ps2-2.4` against `mwcc-ps2-2.3`), so the rule is keyed to the era it was derived and measured on. A program of an unknown compiler keeps it.

rules.note: A direct branch out of a function whose target is code, sits in no body another entry proved, and whose own flow decodes to a terminator is a tail call to a function; its target is promoted to a function entry (discovery's `promote_tailcalls`). rules.note: These compilers put each function's literal pool right behind the function, and the symbol size they emit runs through it, so the flow walk's proven body (which ends at the last return) reads short: 0.43-0.83 of the GBA and NDS functions that truth sizes. The size of a function is extended through the pool its own PC-relative word loads name, never past the next entry, never over a decoded instruction, never over more words than its own loads can name, and never over a size the image's symbol table declared. Found on pokeemerald, Fire Emblem 8 and pokeheartgold; the two guards came from kh-chain-of-memories (a pool in the middle of a function) and nascar-heat-2002 (hand-written assembly sharing one pool), which are therefore derived, not held out. Held out (LOO, size_exact on -> off): golden-sun 0.318 -> 0.981, klonoa 0.168 -> 0.957, dragon-quest-iv 0.469 -> 0.992, kh-358-2-days 0.439 -> 0.995, kh-recoded 0.459 -> 0.997, pokemon-platinum 0.567 -> 0.999, world-ends-with-you 0.440 -> 0.994; recall, precision and decompile success unchanged.

rules.note: CodeWarrior prologues that keep many callee-saved registers call _savegpr_N/_restgpr_N/_savefpr_N/_restfpr_N, runtime sleds that store (or load) rN..r31 (fN..f31) at negative offsets from r11. The importer names a sled entry when the bytes prove it (the words from that entry to the closing blr are exactly the helper's instructions); the worker gives each helper a call fixup so the decompiler sees the stores and loads instead of an opaque call. Layout read off Animal Crossing main.dol 0x8009ae00..0x8009af2c.
